summary: Join our Sustainable Horticulture Production Training Course to master innovative techniques for environmentally responsible gardening and farming practices.
lede: Sustainable horticulture brings crop planning, soil and water management, and pest control together to support productive, resilient farm systems. For farm managers, owners, agriculture officers, extension staff, and others working with horticulture production, the course provides practical ways to plan seasonal crops, apply integrated pest management, and improve traceability and postharvest handling to meet buyer needs and reduce losses.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for a wide range of professionals involved in planning, managing, supporting, financing, or evaluating horticulture production systems.
modules: Crop Planning, Variety Selection, and Seasonal Scheduling
Soil Health and Fertility Management for Horticulture
Water Management and Efficient Irrigation Systems
Integrated Pest Management (IPM) for Reduced Losses
Disease Prevention, Diagnosis, and Field Hygiene
Good Agricultural Practices (GAP), Food Safety, and Compliance
Quality Standards, Market Access, and Buyer Requirements
Farm Business Management and Production Economics
Climate-Smart Practices for Resilience and Sustainability
Scaling Sustainable Horticulture through Outgrowers and Teams
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of horticulture practices. Experience in agriculture or a related field is recommended but not mandatory.
